summary: First full pass on Oracle by Hariom Realty landing page. Backend: created pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) - 10/10 tests pass covering GET /api/, GET /api/health, POST /api/leads (happy path + persistence via GET, default source) and 5 invalid-payload validation cases. Frontend: desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (375x812) Playwright runs - hero + CTAs render, header Register Interest smooth-scrolls to enquiry, empty-form submit shows all 5 inline errors and makes NO POST, happy path submits and shows enquiry-success with lead persisted in MongoDB (verified via GET /api/leads: full_name=Awwwards Tester, source=oracle_landing). Counts verified: 12 floor plan tiles, 6 residence rows, 10 amenities, 10 connectivity rows, 6 spec rows, 5 manifesto items, 6 gallery items. Placeholder PDF returns 200 (application/pdf). floating-whatsapp href = https://wa.me/917045955955?text=... , floating-call = tel:+917045955955. Mobile menu toggle opens nav with 5 links + Register Interest CTA and closes on selection; mobile form submit also succeeds. No horizontal overflow on mobile (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 375). No console errors observed.

ui_bugs.issue: Two Unsplash URLs return HTTP 404 so images never load: IMAGES.gallery[4] 'photo-1600607687644-c7171b42498b' (gallery-item-4) and IMAGES.amenityBg 'photo-1600585154154-cbdcd35ac2ba' (amenities section background). Verified via curl -> 404 and document.images naturalWidth==0.

Mobile nav links and mobile Register Interest CTA had no data-testid (only the hidden desktop nav had them), making mobile nav untestable. FIXED by test agent: added mobile-nav-link-{id} and mobile-header-enquire-btn.

data-testid of the property-type button CHANGES to 'enquiry-property-type-selected' once selected, so the documented id (e.g. enquiry-property-type-2-bhk) disappears after click. Fragile for automation and for re-selecting; prefer a stable testid plus aria-pressed/data-state.

issues: The '+' in '+91 7045955955' renders as a tiny superscript-looking glyph in Bodoni Moda and looks clipped/misaligned against the digits - consider rendering '+91' in the sans font or increasing line-height
Badge text reads 'BUILDING REALITIES · EST.' with a missing year after 'EST.'
MahaRERA QR block is an intentional placeholder box (renders as a bare pattern square) - needs the real QR before launch
floating-call is md:hidden so only WhatsApp shows on desktop; spec asks for floating WhatsApp+Call - confirm this is intended
~400px of empty space between the end of the enquiry card and the footer after success state renders; feels unbalanced

action_items: Replace the two 404 Unsplash images in /app/frontend/src/data/oracle.js (IMAGES.gallery[4], IMAGES.amenityBg) with working, brand-appropriate (warm/neutral luxury) imagery. Note gallery[1] is a blue-clad facade and gallery[3]/[5] are generic US-style interiors that clash with the deep-brown/gold editorial palette.
Keep a stable data-testid on property-type buttons instead of swapping to '-selected'.
Fill in footer 'EST.' year and replace MahaRERA QR placeholder.
Confirm whether floating Call button should also appear on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined at the bottom of the module but referenced inside create_lead - works at runtime but move logging setup above route definitions.
server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers.
server.py: POST /api/leads returns 200; a create endpoint should return 201. No rate limiting / duplicate-lead guard on a public form endpoint - abuse risk.
server.py: GET /api/leads is unauthenticated and exposes all lead PII (name, mobile, email) publicly. Should be protected before launch. (HIGH)
Enquiry.jsx: mobile is only validated client-side as 10 digits; backend allows 10-15 chars with no digit regex - add pattern validation server-side.
Reveal.jsx LineReveal uses viewport amount:0.5 with once:true; for very large multi-line headings this can delay reveal noticeably on fast/anchor scrolls.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 leads in MongoDB 'leads' collection during testing (2 prefixed TEST_, plus tester@oracle.example and mobile@oracle.example from UI runs). Safe to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT screenshot artifact: LineReveal headings (h2) frequently appear BLANK in full-viewport Playwright screenshots even though computed transform is 'none', opacity 1 and correct color; a clipped screenshot of the same region renders the text correctly. Do NOT report missing headings as a bug - verify with page.screenshot(clip=...) or by reading computed styles. Backend suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (10 tests, all green). Mobile nav testids now exist: mobile-nav-link-{overview|residences|amenities|location|enquiry}, mobile-header-enquire-btn.
rca_of_the_issue: The two non-loading images are simply dead Unsplash photo IDs (HTTP 404 from images.unsplash.com), not a code defect; swapping the URLs in data/oracle.js resolves it.
